reason: Expand missing currency/investor factors and update the price and real-yield evidence

evidence.content: FRED DFII10 showed the 10-year inflation-indexed Treasury yield at 2.85% for 24 September 2026, after 2.76% for 23 September. The page was updated on 25 September; later observations were not verified.

WGC linked the August 2026 gold rally to ETF/futures demand and a weaker dollar. Those monthly observations add investor-flow and currency channels; they do not establish that August momentum persists in late September.

Reuters reported gold at USD 4,171.85 per troy ounce at 06:27 UTC on 28 September 2026, down 2.7%. Its report described higher oil prices and renewed rate-hike expectations, with unresolved US–Iran diplomacy. This updates the earlier spot reference.
